definitions: A measurable extent of some kind, such as length, breadth, depth, or height.
An aspect or feature of a situation, problem, or thing.
A property of space; extension in a given direction.
A fundamental physical quantity, such as length, mass, or time, in terms of which all other physical quantities can be expressed.
examples: The room's dimensions are 4 by 5 metres.
There's a political dimension to the problem.
Velocity has dimensions of length divided by time.
